normalized_requirement: Provide a local URL shortener with link creation, redirect, aggregate click analytics, persistent SQLite storage, health/readiness endpoints, tests and setup docs.
assumptions: 8-character codes with a cryptographically secure generator.
Analytics are aggregate click counts only, no visitor identity.

acceptance_criteria.statement: POST /api/links creates a link and returns code, short_url, url, created_at with 201.
GET /r/{code} returns 302 to the target and increments click_count once; unknown code returns 404.
GET /api/links/{code}/stats returns code, url, created_at, click_count; unknown returns 404.
Invalid URLs (bad scheme, credentials, control chars, overlong) are rejected with 422.
healthz and readyz report liveness and database readiness; readyz is 503 when the database is unavailable.
Data persists across restarts and concurrent redirects do not lose click updates.

notes: Greenfield; target contract fully specifies behavior, no clarification needed.
